name: Le bureau du docteur

items.scene: A seasick sailor, cheeks slightly green, holds his NOSE ("noh-ZAY") as NAUSEA rolls over him in the patient's chair.
A sudden OUTBREAK ("ee-rewp-SYOHN"): a basket of kittens on a stool ERUPTS in sneezes, ribbons flying.
A giraffe pokes her long neck in at the window for a CONSULTATION ("kohn-sewl-tah-SYOHN"), sticking out a sore tongue.
A little doctor mouse turns the pages of a TOME ("sanp-TOHM") as big as a door, looking up a SYMPTOM.
A boy with a COLD and a red nose sits wrapped in a blanket, his used tissues piled so high they fill the ROOM ("REWM").
A brave teddy bear holds out his paw for a VACCINE ("vahk-SAN") and gets a gold star sticker; the capped syringe is a harmless prop.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le bureau du docteur in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (east). Camera: close view of the doctor's desk corner by the window, same duck-egg room.
Setting: the same pale duck-egg walls and white dado, a tall bookcase of medical books behind the desk; floor: the same black-and-white checkerboard tiles. Landmark: the big oak desk with a green banker's lamp under the sash window with the chestnut tree. Light: clear morning light from the window. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the checkerboard floor in the near foreground (the way back out).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- left, middle distance: A seasick sailor, cheeks slightly green, holds his NOSE as NAUSEA rolls over him in the patient's chair.
- left, foreground: A sudden OUTBREAK: a basket of kittens ERUPTS in sneezes on the desk corner, ribbons flying.
- centre, middle distance: A giraffe pokes her long neck in at the window for a CONSULTATION, sticking out a sore tongue.
- centre-right, foreground: A little doctor mouse turns the pages of a TOME as big as a door, looking up a SYMPTOM.
- right, middle distance: A boy with a COLD and a red nose sits wrapped in a blanket, his used tissues piled so high they fill the ROOM.
- far right, foreground: A brave teddy bear holds out his paw for a VACCINE and gets a gold star sticker; the capped syringe is a harmless prop.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
